players.product: Revio and Vega HiFi long-read sequencing platforms

quarterly_data.signal: Pacific Biosciences' Q2 2026 earnings release: PacBio commenced sequencing and sample delivery for Basecamp Research, which it describes as a frontier AI lab for therapeutic design - a significant operational milestone for PacBio's largest population-scale program to date. Q2 instrument revenue included an order for several Revio systems from a new population-scale customer.

Pacific Biosciences' Q2 2026 earnings release: the SPRQ-Nx chemistry being rolled out globally includes DeepConsensus, an AI-powered consensus algorithm co-developed with Google, together with enhanced methylation detection.

Pacific Biosciences' Q2 2026 earnings release: non-GAAP gross margin was 36% versus 38% in Q2 2025 (GAAP 32% versus 37%), the decline primarily driven by higher compute and memory costs, Vega manufacturing transition costs and lower Revio average selling prices on strategic multi-system placements. Year-ago comparisons: Revio placements 20 versus 15, Vega placements 26 versus 38, annualized Revio pull-through per system ~$202,000 versus ~$219,000.
quarterly_data.figure: non-GAAP gross margin 36% (vs 38%); GAAP 32% (vs 37%); Revio placements 20 (vs 15); Vega 26 (vs 38); pull-through ~$202,000 (vs ~$219,000)

quarterly_data.signal: New CEO Mark Van Oene (effective August 5, 2026): PacBio continues its 'pivot into further supporting the clinical markets and developing AI-related product solutions and clinically relevant databases', and aims at 'playing a leading role in developing AI-related HiFi sequencing solutions and databases'.

Pacific Biosciences' 8-K (Item 2.05): on July 30, 2026 the Board approved a restructuring plan with operating expense reductions and a reduction in force of approximately 40 employees, or approximately 8% of the workforce; including related non-headcount cost actions, PacBio expects to reduce annualized operating expenses by $30 million to $40 million by the end of 2027, with approximately $2.0 million of pre-tax charges expected in the third quarter of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: ~40 employees (~8% of workforce); annualized opex reduction $30 million to $40 million by end of 2027; ~$2.0 million pre-tax charges (Q3 2026)
